title: How AI is making music producers obsolete

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this — AI just made a hit song in 30 seconds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Music producers are losing their jobs faster than you can say "streaming."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI tools like MusicLM can generate full tracks from just a few words.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses neural networks trained on millions of songs to mimic any style.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Producers, engineers, and even A&R execs are feeling the pressure now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future of music creation is in your hands — literally.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how AI writes your next favorite song?
